source.title: Mandaic Magic Bowls in the Moussaieff Collection: A Preliminary Survey
source.container_title: New Inscriptions and Seals Relating to the Biblical World
source.citation: Morgenstern, Matthew. “Mandaic Magic Bowls in the Moussaieff Collection: A Preliminary Survey.” In New Inscriptions and Seals Relating to the Biblical World, 157–170. Society of Biblical Literature, 2012. https://doi.org/10.2307/j.ctt32bzp2.17.
source.notes: JSTOR exposes chapter metadata and indexed text but full access was unavailable. The chapter explicitly reports nine Mandaic bowls. Later papers published five in 2021 and four in 2025; exact paper-to-object mapping remains a review lead.

summary: One of nine Mandaic-script incantation bowls identified in the Shlomo Moussaieff Collection by Morgenstern's 2012 survey.

entries.notes: Eleven well-preserved lines in a clear scribal hand for Asmandad son of Marta; a series of bonds for celestial realms.
Fifteen-line continuous text for Dād-Manda son of Iboi; parallels BM 91775 (086M) and MS 2054/34.
Mandaic bowl enumerated and described in the nine-bowl preliminary survey.
Nine-line, well-preserved continuous text whose interpretation is complicated by vulgar script and orthography.
Sixteen-line continuous text for the children of Eboi and their families; closely parallels M24.

claims.value_text: Children of Eboi and their families

entries.notes: Exceptionally large bowl with an image of a long-haired demon bound at arms and legs.

claims.value_text: Large long-haired demon bound at arms and legs

entries.notes: Thirteen-line continuous, well-preserved formula for Azyazdan Khwast-Bindad son of Madukh.
First of two unnumbered Mandaic bowls distinguished by the survey.
Second of two unnumbered Mandaic bowls distinguished by the survey.

leads.description: Map Morgenstern's 2021 five-bowl edition and Morgenstern–Abudraham's 2025 four-bowl edition exactly onto the nine Mandaic objects M23, M24, M25, M26, M45, M139, M154, unnumbered A, and unnumbered B; capture the full texts and translations through authorized access.
